summary: CVS Phase 1 full-stack testing complete. Backend: 18/18 pytest tests pass (non-regression on cities/pois/progress/quest/leaderboard, eligibility gate, dim validation per category, comment length, verified check-in gate, review author population, CVS aggregation with dim_avg + cq_score). Frontend: CVS card renders on POI detail with big 93/100 score circle, breakdown weights (0.33/0.00/0.67), dimension pills (Exhibition/Information/Authenticity/Accessibility), and gated 'Check in first to write a review' CTA for fresh sessions. Tapping the write-review CTA correctly navigates to /review/{poiId} and renders the 'Verified visitors only' gate for un-checked-in users. After seeding a check-in, the review form correctly renders Overall + 4 landmark dims, a comment counter ('20 more characters' → 'X/1000'), and disables Submit until stars + 20-char comment are provided. The /reviews/{poiId} page renders with sort chips (Most helpful / Newest first). No P0/P1 issues found.
critical_code_review_comments: Nice pattern: create_review uses upsert on (poi_id,device_id) so a user re-rating a place overwrites cleanly.
The /cvs fallback formula (blend = n / CVS_MIN_REVIEWS) is well thought — 93.3 with 1 review (cq=100, google=90) matches spec.

Minor: RESTAURANT_DIMS/OTHER_DIMS lists are duplicated between server.py and /app/frontend/app/review/[poiId].tsx. If a 5th dim is ever added, both must be updated. Consider exposing dims via /api/pois/{id} metadata or a /config endpoint (non-blocking).
server.py is 1414 lines (>700) — consider splitting the CVS module into a separate router file to keep server.py lean (non-blocking, defer to Phase 2).
seed_data_creation: Tests seeded 2 TEST_cvs_* devices with check-ins & reviews; all TEST_cvs_* rows deleted post-run. One pre-existing 'TestUser' review (dev_test_1782981994) created by main agent's curl remains — left intact so the CVS card continues to display the ~93/100 score referenced in the review request.
context_for_next_testing_agent: CVS Phase 1 stable. Backend regression file: /app/backend/tests/test_cvs_reviews.py (idempotent, uses fresh TEST_cvs_ device per module). For future frontend work on the review form, note that star testIDs include emoji in the label (e.g. 'star-⭐-Overall-Experience-5') — safer to add a stable non-emoji testID prop if you plan to test in CI with strict selectors. Frontend browser device_id at time of test: dev_1782982343170_mx4sjucr (has a Castle check-in — will expire in 24h).
